Home.exploreDescription: Nonuru ripodho kuom kuonde, weche, dhok, kod sa mondo ungʼe gik matimore e piny.
Home.faq1Answer: Watchtower en gima tiyoe e ripodho mag dhok mangʼeny kendo e winjo gik malosore e piny, miyo ji teko mar ripodho weche mag alworni kod ketho mag ratiro e dhok ma giwuoyogo. Ripodho mondo ongor, oikel e karta kendo olok chuth mondo ngʼere gik ma timore kendo kony timo gik madongo.
Home.faq2Answer: Inyalo ripodho gik ma timore kaka ketho mag ratiro, chandruok mar ranyisi kod weche mamoko mag alworni motimore e oganda mari — gimoro amora ma jomoko onego ngʼe kata manyalo konyo e winjo kaka ichalo.
Home.faq3Answer: Ee. Inyalo ripodho ka iwuoyo kata ka indiko e dho ma in gi yie kode, kendo Watchtower konyo ndiko, loko kendo chiko ripodhi mond owinjre e dhok duto.
Home.faq4Answer: Ee. Kik ngʼer kata bedo ma ongʼere en a rane, ok an ranyis — in bende ok nyaka mi nyingi kata wach moro amora ma nyalo nyisoe ngʼa in mondo iripodh.
Home.faq4Question: Inyalo keto ripodhi ka ok ingʼere?
Home.faq5Answer: Ripodh moro amora nyalo nengore kendo oketi e karta kod mamoko mond owinjre timbe, kendo omiyo ogendini, chuni gi udi mamoko ma nyalo tiyo kuome.
Home.faqsDescription: Ngʼe moloyo kuom ripodho, dhok, penjo mar wich kuot kod kaka Watchtower konyo mondo wach mag oganda obed motiyo.
Home.heroDescription: Watchtower miyo ji teko mar ripodho weche mag alworni kod ketho mag ratiro e dhok ma giwuoyogo mondo ngʼato ka ngʼato riwre e ngima mar oganda kod miyo joma nigi diragruok luor.
Home.howItWorksDescription: Koa e ripodho achiel nyaka lokruok maduongʼ, ma e kaka WatchTower miyo oganda teko mar winjre kendo kelo lokruok makelo tich.
Home.insightsDescription: Ne moko e yo moro amora mar ripodho mag oganda, chiro muom, teku mar dhok mangʼeny kod kaka wach maber nyalo konyo timo gik madongo.
Home.insightsFallback1Title: Angʼo momiyo dwond ji mar polo tek e winjo gik ma timore e piny
Home.insightsFallback2Title: Goyo kendo lingʼe mar dhok e ripodho mag oganda
Home.insightsFallback3Title: Koa e ripodho mag ngʼato ka ngʼato nyaka e weche madongo
Home.insightsHeading: Paro, sigandini kod ngʼerono makin goto.
Home.speakNaturallyDescription: Watchtower ondiko, oloko kendo ochiko ripodh moro amora mondo wach owinjre, kata ripodh rnotim e dho mane.
Home.step1Description: Wachiwo teknolojia makonyo ji kod oganda ripodho weche mag oganda kata ketho mag ratiro tir koa e simu kata kompyuta e dhok ma giwuoyogo.
Home.step2Description: Wanono kendo wasiro ripodho ka ripodho, ka waketo gik motimore e ramaki kendo wanyiso kit wach mane dhi bedo mopondo. Fweny manoko lokore ngʼeyo maler kendo mochanore maber manyiso wach maduongʼ.
Home.step3Description: Oganda, riwruok, kod kanyakla yudo ngʼeyogi mondo giger weche, gimi joma nigi diragruok luor, kendo gidhi nyime gi lokruok makelo tich, kotenore gi ranyisi madier koa e piny.
Home.impactDescription: Nonuru kaka oganda winjre, keto paro, kendo kelo lokruok.
About.ctaDescription: Or ripodh gima notimore e dhogi. Onge akaunt madwarore, onge fweny mari giwegi madwarore.
About.faqAccountAnswer: Onge profael mar chweyo kata donjo ma iluwo. Ibiro, ior ripodho, iwuok. Onge gima tweyi gi gima ioro.
About.faqDeviceAnswer: Ee. WatchTower ok kan fweny mag sesheni kata cookies motwere gi gima ioro. Ripodho koa e gir tiyo moriw ok ket e masira.
About.faqDeviceQuestion: Be anyalo ripodho koa e gir tiyo moriw kata mar ji duto?
About.faqEncryptionAnswer: Gik duto miorogo osiegi chakre sa ma iorogo. Ripodhi ok nyal manege kata dwokore iri e kinde mar oro.
About.faqEncryptionQuestion: Be gima aoro nyalo yudore ka odwogo ira?
About.faqIdentityAnswer: Ok onego ichiw nyingi, namba mar simu, kata fweny moro amora manyiso ngʼeyo mondo ior ripodho. Pondo en gima jare, ok gima opogore.
About.faqIdentityQuestion: Be ng'eyo mara orit ka aoro ripodho?
About.faqVisibilityAnswer: Ripodhi nonre mana gi jorito mag WatchTower mosir. Gima ioro ok opog e lela gi fweny moro amora manyiso ngʼeyo.
About.heroDescription: WatchTower en kanyakla mar rieko mar oganda ma tiyo gi AI kod teknolojia mag dhok mag alworni mondo omi ji nyal ripodho gik motimore, masira, kod ketho mag ratiro e dhogi giwegi, kendo loko ripodhogo obed ngʼeyo minyalo tiyego ne miyo luor kod dwoko wach.
About.languagesDescription: WatchTower sani konyo dhok {count} mondo omi dwond oganda mangʼeny nyal riwo lwete, winji, kendo kony e miyo luor e dhok ma giparo ni owinjorene moloyo.
About.objectiveDescription: Sirruok ni ngʼato ka ngʼato nigi teko mar ripodho gik motimore e oganda e dhok mowuoyego, mondo onge dwol ma ok owinji kendo ngʼato ka ngʼato nyalo riwo lwete e miyo joma nigi diragruok luor.
About.safetyDescription: Wangʼeyo ni wuoyo nyalo kelo masira. Ma e kaka WatchTower ogero mondo orit.
Security.metaDescription: Kaka inyalo ripodho ketho mag dwokruok gi diragruok ne jokonyo mag AmplifiedAccess.
Security.heroDescription: Kaka warito ripodhi mag ketho kod singruok mawa mar lando gi diragruok.
Security.intro: AmplifiedAccess kawo dwokruok mar WatchTower gi pek. Wagoyo erokamano ne tich mar jonon dwokruok kod jo-oganda makonyowa rito ohala ka en gi dwokruok ne ngʼato ka ngʼato.
Security.reportingWarning: Kik iripodh ketho mag dwokruok kokalo e penjo mag GitHub mag lela.
Security.reportingInstruction: Kar timo kamano, ripodhgi tir ne jokonyowa gi imel:
Security.reportingResponseTime: Onego iyud dwoko ei sa 48. Ka ok iyudo, luw wach gi imel mondo isir ni waseyudo wach mari mokwongo.
Security.whatToIncludeIntro: Mondo ikonywa nonon ripodhoni piyo, ket gik maluwogi kaka inyalo:
Security.includeItem1: Kit ketho (kaka SQL injection, cross-site scripting, authentication bypass, privilege escalation, kod mamoko)
Security.includeItem2: Yo duto mar fweny sokoni moriwore gi kaka ketho nofwenyore
Security.includeItem3: Kama code mohinyore ni — bade, commit hash, kata URL tir
Security.includeItem4: Kido moro amora mopogore madwarore mondo ochak ketho kendo
Security.includeItem5: Chike mokuong mokuong mar chako ketho kendo
Security.includeItem6: Ranyisi mar paro kata code mar exploit, ka onyalore
Security.includeItem7: Wach mar ketho, koriwo kaka jamonj nyalo tiyo kode
Security.disclosurePolicy: AmplifiedAccess luwo chik mar <link>Lando Ketho ma Oriwore</link>. Wakwayo mondo iwewa gi kinde moromo mar nonon kod loso ketho moripodhi ka pok olande e lela.
Security.disclosureFollowUp: Wabiro miyi ngʼeyo kuom kaka wadhi nyime e nonro kendo wabiro miyi pak kuom yudo mari ka idwaro.
Security.languageText: Wadwaro mondo weche duto mag dwokruok obed e Dhok Ingriz.
CodeOfConduct.metaDescription: Chike mag oganda mag AmplifiedAccess kod chik mar kido ne jokonyo kod jodonjo.
CodeOfConduct.heroDescription: Singruokwa ne oganda ma yawore, marwako ji, kendo maonge sand ne ngʼato ka ngʼato.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText1: Wan kaka jo-oganda, jokonyo, kod jotelo mag AmplifiedAccess wasingore mondo donjo e oganda mawa obed gima onge sand ne ngʼato ka ngʼato, kik idew higni, duongʼ mar del, chandruok mineno kata ma ok ineni, dhoot, kido mar ich, paro kod nyiso mar ich, rieko, puonjruok, chal mar pesa e oganda, pinje, kido mar del, dhoot, kaka ing'e gi, rangi, din, kata ich kod hero.
CodeOfConduct.pledgeText2: Wasingore mondo watim kendo wawuo e yore makelo oganda ma yawore, marwako ji, mopogore, marwako ji duto, kendo mangima maber.
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositiveIntro: Ranyisi mag kido makelo kama ber oriwo:
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive1: Nyiso kech kod ngʼwono ne joweteni
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive2: Miyo luor paro mopogore, neno, kod puonjruok
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive3: Chiwo kod rwako gi ngʼwono weche makonyo dongruok
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive4: Kawo diragruok kod kwayo ngʼwono ne joma ohinyore gi kethowa, kendo puonjore koa e wach mosetimore
CodeOfConduct.standardsPositive5: Keto paro e gima ber ok mana ne wan ka wan wawegi, to ne oganda duto
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegativeIntro: Ranyisi mag kido ma ok oyie oriwo:
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative1: Tiyo gi dhok kata picha mag ich, kod paro kata dwaro mar ich mar kit moro amora
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative2: Chwanyo ji, weche mag yanyo kata jaro, kod monj kuom ngʼato kata kuom siasa
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative3: Sand e lela kata e mumbo
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative4: Golo fweny mag mumbo mag jomoko, kaka kar dak kata sirani mar imel, ka onge yweyo mowinjore
CodeOfConduct.standardsNegative5: Kido moro amora machielo ma dine ineno ni ok owinjore e tich mar teknolojia
CodeOfConduct.enforcementResponsibilitie: Jotelo mag oganda mag AmplifiedAccess nigi tich mar lero kod rito chikwa mag kido moyie kendo ginitim gima owinjore kendo makare kuom kido moro amora ma ginineno ni ok owinjore, ma bwogo ji, ma yanyo, kata makelo hinyruok.

Jotelo mag oganda nigi ratiro kod tich mar golo, loko, kata kwedo weche, commits, code, lokruok mag wiki, penjo, kod jokonyo mamoko ma ok oriwore gi Chik mar Kido ni, kendo ginilando gimomiyo giketo paro mar rito ka dwarore.
CodeOfConduct.scopeText: Chik mar Kido ni tiyo e kuonde duto mag oganda, kendo bende otiyo ka ngʼato ochungʼ kar oganda mar AmplifiedAccess e lela. Ranyisi mag chungʼ kar oganda mawa oriwo tiyo gi sirani mar imel mowinjore, ndiko kokalo e akaunt mar sosal midia mowinjore, kata bedo jachungʼ moyier e nyasi mar intanet kata ma ok mar intanet.
CodeOfConduct.reportingIntro: Gik motimore mag kido marach, sand, kata gimoro machielo ma ok oyie inyalo ripodho ne jokonyo mag AmplifiedAccess e:
CodeOfConduct.reportingFollowUp: Ywagruok duto nonon kendo nonon mapiyo kendo makare. Jotelo duto mag oganda nigi tich mar miyo luor mumbo kod dwokruok mar ngʼat moro amora moripodho gimoro.
CodeOfConduct.guidelinesIntro: Jotelo mag oganda noluw chike magi ka giketo paro kuom gima biro timore kuom tim moro amora ma ginineno ni oketho Chik mar Kido ni:
CodeOfConduct.correctionImpactText: Tiyo gi dhok ma ok owinjore kata kido machielo ma ok oneno kaka mar teknolojia kata ma ok yier e oganda.
CodeOfConduct.correctionConsequenceText: Siem mar mumbo mondik moa kuom jotelo mag oganda, machiwo ler kuom kit ketho kod lero gimomiyo kido ne ok owinjore. Kwayo ngʼwono e lela nyalo dwarore.
CodeOfConduct.warningImpactText: Ketho motimore kokalo e gimoro achiel kata timo mangʼeny.
CodeOfConduct.warningConsequenceText: Siem ma gin gik biro timore ka kido odhi nyime. Onge wuoyo gi jomoko moriwore, koriwo wuoyo ma ok odwar gi joma rito Chik mar Kido, kuom kinde moket. Ketho chikegi nyalo kelo kwer mar sa manok kata mar kinde duto.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanImpactText: Ketho maduongʼ mar chikwa mag oganda, koriwo kido ma ok owinjore modhi nyime.
CodeOfConduct.temporaryBanConsequenceTex: Kwer mar sa manok mar wuoyo kata lando wach e lela gi oganda kuom kinde moket. Onge wuoyo e lela kata e mumbo gi jomoko moriwore koyie e kinde ni. Ketho chikegi nyalo kelo kwer mar kinde duto.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanImpactText: Nyiso kit ketho chikwa mag oganda, koriwo kido ma ok owinjore modhi nyime, sand ne ngʼato achiel, kata monj kata jaro kuom kit ji.
CodeOfConduct.permanentBanConsequenceTex: Kwer mar kinde duto mar wuoyo e lela mar kit moro amora ei oganda.
CodeOfConduct.attributionText: Chik mar Kido ni olos koa e <covenantLink>Contributor Covenant</covenantLink>, gino mar 2.1, moyudore e <versionLink>contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct</versionLink>.
PrivacyPolicyPage.heading: Mumbo mari nigi teko.
PrivacyPolicyPage.intro: WatchTower oger mondo kony ji wach gima timore e ogendni ka ginyalo yiero kaka giripogo weche.
